summary: Frontend-only verification: captured console via init-script wrapper (console.error/warn) across full loops of 4 reels at 1440x900. Zero 'Cannot update a component (StorytimeTemplate/MythVsFactTemplate) while rendering a different component (ReelPlayer)' warnings. Zero console errors on all tested reels. The queueMicrotask deferral in both templates successfully fixes the render-phase setState emitted by framer-motion's useTransform sync in useMotionValueEvent subscribers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_12 confirmed the queueMicrotask setState deferral in StorytimeTemplate.tsx and MythVsFactTemplate.tsx eliminates the render-phase React warning. Verified on /r/the-outreach-part-1 (storytime, 15s loop), /r/myth-you-need-a-referral (myth flip, 15s loop), /r/marge-reviews-saurav (live comments, 10s), /r/breaking-built-by-voice (ticker, 10s). All counts: cannot-update=0, errors=0. Console wrapper installed via page.add_init_script before navigation so React's dedup didn't hide repeat occurrences.
rca of the issue: Previously, framer-motion 11.18 useTransform.updateValue() ran synchronously on every render and emitted a 'change' event, invoking subscriber setState mid-render (warning). Fix: templates use useMotionValueEvent with queueMicrotask(() => setState(...)), deferring the state update until after render completes.
